And when you sign up, you’re going to get access to my member portal that houses all of my programs and courses in. And you’re going to get access to this course. And I’m going to tell you what’s inside of it because you’re going to get on-demand access to The Revenue Challenge process, which is ten videos, and it’s going to walk you through how to do the Challenge, creating a value plan for the Challenge, getting in the Challenge mindset, recovering from setbacks, everything that you could possibly think that’s going to come up during your Challenge, there is a video to help you through that. So there’s a process on demand.

You’re also going to get a curated list. I went through—and when I say curated, it’s not a fancy term. Okay? I’m going to tell you what I did here. I’ve been doing this Challenge since again, 2018, I think, 2019, since the beginning of 200k. And I went through every past Mastermind last year, and I found The Revenue Challenge in all of our—when you join 200k, you get every past coaching call that we have, I believe. And so there’s hundreds of them. And so I went through each past Mastermind.

I found the month that we did The Revenue Challenge, and I watched the calls, and I chose a list of the best ones. Coaching calls where I gave, I started the call and gave people exercises to help them deep dive in their brain and get them in a better place for the Challenge, to really critically think, to super think on their Challenge, to open up their belief systems, to find out where they’re lacking in their belief, to align their energy. I found the calls where I coached someone the best, and was like, “Oh my God, everybody needs to see this coaching.”

I curated a list of those past coaching calls, and you’re going to get access to those as well. I believe there’s 10 or 11 of those calls, but they’re my top coaching calls from every Challenge I’ve ever run in the 200k Mastermind. You’ll have access to those as well. So it’s going to—you’re going to get coaching from me right away, just in those calls.

And then you also get access to my Creating Demand training. It’s a five-day training. That is, if you need extra encouragement along the way. That is, if you—it’s one of the things I actually did this as a free training, but I don’t release it all the time. And it’s one of the most asked-about free trainings I ever did.

People were like, “All I did for five days straight is coach people on the thought, ‘I am in demand.'” And it was revolutionary. It changed people. They were like, “To watch someone be coached on one thought for five days straight, ‘I am in demand,'” because of how you show up when you believe that. When you believe that one single thought, everything changes. So you’re going to get access to that as well.

Then, starting November 6th, we’re going to have live calls where I will be there coaching you and supporting the entire group as we go through the Challenge together. So you can start the Challenge now. You can wait till November 6th. You can watch all the videos and get yourself prepared. You get to decide how you want to go through it. But I’m going to be doing technically seven calls.

So there’s going to be six live Challenge calls, and on those calls, what will happen is I am going to be watching the Facebook community. I’m going to be reading your posts. I’m going to be absorbing the energy of what’s happening as the group goes through it. And I’m going to be thinking about what I need to say to you to get you going in the Challenge. I’m going to be thinking about how I can make the most, the most of you, the most successful. Though I do a lot of watching in this, in this time, and a lot of thinking about what’s happening for the group because I know what’s happened for me year after year after year.

But I’m, every group is different. Every time I run this in 200k, there are different things that emerge watching the group, and those are the things—like the process is this is true for everyone that ever goes through the Challenge. That’s already been recorded, and you’ll get that as soon as you sign up.

But for the individual group, I’m looking at what do I need to say individually to this group at this point in time in this moment of the world, of the life, of business, of everything. So I’ll get on and maybe share 10 or 20 minutes of my thoughts of what I’m seeing in the group and how I can help, and then we’re just going to straight coach.

It’s going to be the room to be in. And it will end—the final call, I believe, is—don’t quote me on this. When you comment revenue, you’ll get the link, and it has the call schedule on it, but I believe the final call is December 6th-ish, so it runs for over a 30-day period.

But I’m going to give you access from the moment you sign up, now all the way through the end of December. Happy holidays. Merry Christmas. I want you to be able to do the Challenge, and if it takes you longer than 30 days, you’re going to learn this. Like one of the things I teach in the Challenge is if you do the Challenge and you don’t make the money in the Challenge, you don’t quit.

You don’t say, “Oh, I didn’t do it. I have to start over.” You keep going. And you’re like, “Oh, okay. My theory that I thought, my theory for how much time that was going to take me to make this amount of money was 30 days. Let’s see what it really takes if I didn’t do it in 30 days.” I have so many students that are like, “Oh, I did it in 40. I did it in 56.” You keep going. So you’re going to have access to the calls, the Challenge, all of the things, all the way through the end of the year.

I really have had so many years in my business where the final two months of the year were my best months. It was like I had gone through all of the hard work throughout the whole year of becoming someone different. I’d laid the groundwork. I’d shifted. I’d built up value. I’d grown my—I’d done all the hard work, and then it really paid off in the final months. And I believe that’s true for you, too.

I believe that if you’re not on track for your goal that you had hoped to do, I believe that is still possible for you. I also believe if you’re on track, that you could end up the year way further than you anticipated. This is why I created The Revenue Challenge for this coming back as well, is I wanted to support my students who are in my higher-level Masterminds for their final push of the year. And I wanted to create a really solid environment around it.

This will not be a hustle environment. This is going to be we’re making money with calm and confidence, believing we are in demand, creating value plans and executing and executing with a service energy connected to our people in the highest mindset. It’s an energy container, it’s a mindset container, it’s a money-making container. It’s all of those combined, and I’m going to be—that’s what we’re going to be working on.

And if you are going to be on vacation or you’re finishing up a maternity leave, and you sign up and you’re not able to attend the live calls with us, you’ll still have the ability to say like you couldn’t, for whatever reason, you just absolutely couldn’t start the Challenge in November, then you could start it in December and you’ll have the two months full access to it. What else do I need to tell you?

The investment is $1000. I think $999, but $1000. It is a big investment. It’s expensive. And there isn’t another container like this that you can join at this level with this level of money-making people to build this skill set and to create this ability in your business forever. So this is an advanced challenge. I have the investment set higher than any of my other Entrepreneur Series courses because I do want you to consider the Challenge is for you if you believe you could at least make $1000 in 30 days.

If you check into your body and there’s no hope that you can make $1000 in 30 days, if there is no belief, if you were like, “I can’t even entertain it. I would not be able to take that seriously,” then I would sit this one out. I’ll be really honest about it. But if you know with support, encouragement, a process, deep coaching, and a community of people doing the same, that you could at least make $1000, there is absolutely zero reasons or excuses or obstacles to not be in this Challenge.

And if you believe you could make more money than that, if more could be on the table, if you could make $2000, $5000, $10,000, $40,000, it would be ridiculous not to join. Like, no reason, no excuse lines up for it.

Jordan: “Is this something I could use in my real estate business? I’m also considering becoming a real estate coach.”

Yes. Can I just tell you about my house story? Because it’s so crazy. I’ll tell you really quickly, and then I’ll answer the other questions. So, how I even ended up buying this house is that my husband and I had finally moved in together. We weren’t married yet. And we moved into this gated apartment community that had a garage with the apartment. And I thought, after living in my tiny apartment, I’m making $300,000 a year. I mean, we both were like, “This is the biggest life upgrade ever.”

And then my business really started growing, and I don’t know, one Saturday, I just happened to be looking at the realtor.com or something, whatever the app is, and I found this house, and I was like, “We should go look at this house. I don’t think we’re going to buy a house right now.” We had planned to buy a house a year, like stay in the apartment for a year and then buy a house, but the house looked—it had the most beautiful windows. And I was like, “We’ve got to go look at this house.”

We didn’t end up liking the house. It had a very weird kitchen. But all of a sudden, I became very—I started ruminating. I have an obsessive mind. And so once I get on something, I’m on it. And I obsess over it crazy. And so I’m obsessing about houses, and so we start looking at houses. And my thought process was it could take a year to find the right house, so we should start looking now.

So we look at all these houses, but then I start being like, “Oh, no, no, we’re buying a house now.” You know, when you just get committed to something and you’re like, “No, no, we’re buying a house now.” And we found this house that was a seven, six—I don’t know, six out of ten for both of us. It was fine. I mean, it was nice. It was nice. It was a huge upgrade to living in an apartment in Kentucky. But it didn’t hit all of our boxes. And we looked at it three times, and we were going to make an offer on the house.

And then at the last minute, at 10:00 p.m. at night, we decided not to put an offer in. We had looked at this house three times. So we messaged our realtor, and we were like, “We’re going to pass. It’s not a ten out of ten. We still have our lease for another eight months. We have time. I think we should wait.”

And at 11:00 p.m. at night, she said, “This house is going on the MLS tomorrow if you’d like to take a look at it. I believe it’s a ten out of ten for both of you.” And she sent the link. This is not even on the market yet.

And it was a ten out of ten for both of us. And we could not sleep that night. We could not sleep. And we told our realtor, “We must see this house tomorrow, the day it goes on the market. No one else is buying this house. We are buying this house.” We knew we were buying it before we even stepped foot in it, just from the photos.

So at 11:00 a.m. the very next morning, we come look at this house. It was a parade of homes house, so it was a showcase of the builders, like a builder showcase. And so thousands of people had gone through the house. So they were repainting the walls and fixing things in the house, and like construction is happening, and we’re going through this house. We made an offer on the spot, standing in the house, over ask, because I was like, “I’m not getting in a bidding war with anyone on this house. And I know for sure there’s no other house in the Louisville area that like, it’s so modern. We just don’t get houses like this in Louisville. It’s so modern, it’s so beautiful.”

And so we have to have it. And we made an offer and bought it right then. And so my realtor went from no one’s buying—they are not buying this house to making a $650,000 sale in 12 hours. I believe that type of money and that type of sale is available to any business owner at any point. I will be talking to coaches, so I won’t be using real estate examples. I’ll be using coaching examples, but I think anybody, anyone who owns a business has to have this ability to create money on demand. Otherwise, you’re in trouble.

Kim: “How do we determine our goal for the Challenge?” There’s actually a module in the pre-recorded process that you get access to right away that tells you how to do that. I promise you everything has been thought of. How to determine your goal, how to set up your offer, how to do your value plan, all of it is in the pre-recorded process.

All right. I love you all. See you in The Revenue Challenge. If you want to join us, again, I just don’t think there’s a good reason not to if you believe you could make at least $1000 in this Challenge. And even if it takes you all of November and December, but just know you’re going to be in the room with some moneymakers. So that’s okay.

If you want to face your inadequacy, if you want to come up against yourself a little bit, and you’re willing to do that, it changed my life. The fact that I, I think about it all the time, the fact that I was willing to stay in my million-dollar mentoring despite all of the feelings of being not good enough and not belonging. And then the next year, I made 2.5 million dollars. And then the next year, 6.4, and then the next year, I think nine, and the next year, 12. And it was like, “Hell yeah.” Coming up against myself and being willing to choose to belong even when I don’t think I do, that’s another powerful skill set.

All right. I love you all. Have an amazing rest of your week and weekend, and I will see you in The Revenue Challenge.

Hey, if you’re ready to make money as a life coach, I want to invite you to join my 2K for 2K program; where you’re going to make your first $2,000 the hardest part using my simple five-step formula for getting consults and closing new clients. Just head over to StaceyBoehman.com/2Kfor2K. We’ll see you inside.

title: Bonus: The Revenue Challenge
transcript:
W
elcome to the 
Make Money as a Life Coach
®
 
podcast
 
where sales expert and Master Coach Stacey Boehman teaches you how to make your first $2K, $20K, and $200K using her proven formula.

Hi coaches, I’m back. I’m so excited to be coming to you for my first episode since I went on maternity leave. And I have to tell you, first of all, I just think this is such a flex. I am recording this podcast in my office while my toddler naps in his bed and my baby naps in my office with me. So I can hear her doing a little light snore right next to me. And I’m going to record this podcast and hope I don’t wake her up. But that is what I’m doing these days in my life. And for those of you building a business while also having littles at home, I feel you. I really feel you. And it’s possible. We can do this.

I have so much to share with you all. I can’t even tell you, so many breakthroughs this maternity leave, such a profound, deep experience on all ends of the spectrum, good and bad. But I really want to take some time to come back and really collect my thoughts and share them with you when the time feels right, and all the lessons and all the things that I’ve learned in a separate episode. But that’s not what’s happening right now. Right now, I’m not coming back, and everything’s about, you know, what I learned on maternity leave. Like, I’m coming back to create money and to help my students create money.

In the next 30 days. I’m just stepping right back into the current, right back into my favorite thing to teach. I think it really is my favorite thing to teach, and I think I’m the best at teaching it. So I want to invite you to create some money with me in the next 30 days through The Revenue Challenge. If you have never heard of this, it is an, I have offered it 13 prior times as part of my 200k Mastermind. So, typically, you cannot access this outside of the 200k Mastermind or the 2 Million Dollar Group, my advanced masterminds.

But I have offered it as part of an advanced course in my Entrepreneur series one time before last October 2024. And I’m going to offer it just one more time this November 2025. So this is the second time I’m opening it up to the public. It could be the last. I think it’s going to be the last, and I really want you to be a part of it.

I want to teach you how to create money in 30 days. Any amount that feels possible to you. Okay, in the, in the 200k Mastermind, we call it the 25k in 30 Days Challenge. Although, as the group has grown and expanded, we kind of call it The Revenue Challenge inside there as well because some people are doing 10k and some people are doing 50k. So there’s a range. You get to choose.

And I just tell you ahead of time, we actually coach on this in the challenge, but I tell you ahead of time, any amount that feels possible for you, that you can take seriously in a 30-day period. That your brain sees as possibly achievable, and that will offer you small steps to achieving that. It might also offer you big steps. I coach on that in the challenge, too. But something, an amount that you will commit to and work hard to achieve.

And I want to tell you, I keep thinking about this. It’s every round for the last since 2019, however many years that is, seven years. I have thought about this challenge. I have taken new groups through this challenge. I have had my entire maternity leave to think about this challenge, knowing it was coming up for myself, but also for my students. And I genuinely believe that this is, when I think back even to my own business, one of the most important skill sets that you can develop.

Anyone can think a certain amount of money is possible in an infinite time period. Right? Think about it. Like when we in January, when you set your goal and you have the whole year to achieve it, your brain’s going to be like, yeah, I could do 100k. Yeah, I can do 500k. Yeah, I can do a million. But then, three months in is where I start seeing people cave. Six months in, cave even more. Nine months in, they’ve given up completely.

And I would check in with that with you. Like, are you on track for your goal this year? You might be. And let’s surpass your goal then. But if you’re not and you’ve already given up, like that’s something to notice because it’s really easy to be committed and to believe that it’s going to happen when you have either a very long period of time, like a year, or an infinite period where you’re like, one day, I’m going to do that.

But putting a, but putting a 30-day time frame on it shows you everything actually required to do it. That’s why we put the time frame on it, is it shows you what’s actually required. And what’s going to happen, why I call it the challenge, is because everything is going to come up as to why you haven’t done it yet. And you’re going to get to face it head on and overcome it.

So, figuring out how to set a revenue goal that you actually could believe in and take actionable steps toward and achieving it in a finite period, becoming the person who can do this regularly, I believe, is freedom and confidence as an entrepreneur. It means if you think about it, that you’ll be able to give your business what it needs, when it needs it, always. It means unexpected expenses, both personal and professional, will not stress you and stop you. You will learn to solve your problems by just creating money, rather than freaking out, being scared, quitting, going and getting another job, taking a loan. Right?

Like I’ve coached a student this past year, about a year ago, on her brain just goes to like, oh, I’ll take a loan. I need money, I don’t have the money. I’m going to take a loan. And she’s in my 200k Mastermind, and I’m like, no, no, we’re going to start training your brain to think, I have a money problem, I need to solve it, I go create money.

And that’s such a powerful place to be. This doesn’t have to be a hustle place, it doesn’t have to be a negative place, it doesn’t have to be a place where you’re always doing it from a place of being behind. But it is a powerful place to be when you don’t let your brain go anywhere else with solving problems, than “I create the money.”

I heard this once, I can’t remember who. I actually think I’ve heard it from many people, but I remember hearing it very early on in my business that you don’t have, you, no one ever has a money outflow problem. You have a money inflow problem.

Like we are meant to be abundant. Why not have all the things you ever wanted in your life? Why not have the house that you want? Why not have the beautiful furniture you want? Why not take the vacations you want? Why not send your kids to private school? Why not buy the clothes that make you feel gorgeous? Why not be able to invest in the personal trainer? Why not be able to afford DoorDash every day so that you can focus on your business and have food delivered to you? Why not have all the things that you want?

You really actually don’t have a money outflow problem, a desire problem. Like you’re not meant to, oh, the problem is you desire too much. That’s actually not the problem. It’s that you don’t make enough money to support your desires.

And if you believed that was true, if you believed that the solution is to just create more money, then the skill to learn is how to do that on demand, without hustle, without scarcity, without lack. Like, what if you were just a money creator? I have this thing, this challenge, this problem, and I’m going to solve it by creating inflow, by creating money coming in to my business.

What I think you, what you do when you do this, when you start taking your brain to creating money to solving the problem, is you’re overriding the process where there is even a problem. You stop spending any energy on not being totally powerful and in control. And you can learn to develop this skillset, again, with service and connection rather than hustle.

And I really want to encourage you to really think about how you change and how your business changes when you figure out how to create money on demand. Like right now, I am thinking about creating $500,000 extra that wasn’t in the plan for an investment I want to make in my business. It’s a lot of money, y’all.

Like, on top of the money I already make, like the plan for this year was set already. I had my goals, and then I want to invest in my business in the next, I would say at least in the next 12 months, I want to make a $500,000 investment into my business. And I’m like, okay. So how do I solve this? Like I create $500,000 more than I had planned. This does not have to be a hustle experience. And it doesn’t have to be for you either.

It can happen in any amount of money. This can be with $5000. Like I’ve come up with, I remember the first time I had a client ask me to do a VIP weekend, and I’d never done one. And I’m like, I didn’t even know what that was. And I’m like, wait, so what do I do on the weekend? And I asked my coach, this was like literally the first year of my business. And I asked my coach, like, what’s a VIP weekend? What would I do? Like, the student wants to pay me money. They want to give me money to do a VIP weekend with them. I don’t even know where they heard about this, but I don’t know what this is. Like, what do I do?

And she was like, well, I could tell you, but really you just need to experience one. Like, if you want to be in integrity with knowing, like knowing how to really put on a powerful one, you have to have experienced one as a client, like as a student. And the profound impact of being coached for an entire weekend in a luxury setting on something really important in your life. And I agreed. I was like, you know what, you’re right. And I’m like, okay, so I want to do a VIP weekend with you. And she’s like, okay, it’s $13,000. And I was like, okay, I don’t have $13,000. Literally, I do not have that money in my account. I don’t even have the ability, I don’t think to put it on a credit card. So my option is to create the money.

Well, actually, what I see coaches do is the option for them is just not do it. Oh, I don’t have the money. I don’t believe I can create the money. So that’s out for me. I’ll just offer the VIP weekend and do it anyways, even though I have no idea what I’m doing and I don’t know what the experience is like on the client side, but, you know, I’ll just wing it. That’s what most coaches, I see this is how they try to solve the problem. They’re like, I’m just going to do it on my own. I’m going to DIY it. And you can DIY it, and you can DIY with some sort of success. But for me, it’s always, I have to be in integrity with what I’m offering, and I don’t like to DIY anything.

And because of that, I always have, like I’ve developed the skill set of, I have to create the money if I can’t, if I don’t have the money available to me now. And some of you are going to want to expand your capacity for making more money in a shorter time. Again, maybe it’s $50k in 30 days.

And the last question that I think would be helpful to answer on this episode is if you joined the first public Revenue Challenge, do you need to pay to do it again? And the answer is yes. No different than when you sell renewals for your coaching. I sell renewals into all of my advanced-level courses, my Entrepreneur Series containers, and all of my masterminds. They are energetic containers for me. I want the energy to be fresh and the students to be invested, not just doing it because it’s offered again and you have access to it, but invested. There is a different energy in you that shows up, and a different energy in me when you are invested each time. And then we come together at our highest level of investment as the coach and the student to come together in this container.

And this is true for me as a student as well. I have invested over and over in the same containers. I had a one-on-one coach that I renewed for three years. I renewed every four months for three years, over and over and over and over again. I am in a container that has a bunch of courses in it and some live coaching, and I’m about to renew for that same thing for the third year in a row. I typically do things in three-year increments. And it’s not, some of it is new content, like some of the courses get refreshed, and then they have coaching calls. But mostly I’m paying, and it’s a lot of money, but I’m paying to tap in, to be a part of that energy, to have access to take the courses again, to go through the courses as a different version of me.

And every time for me, money is on, every time money’s on the line, it means that return is on the line. And that’s not a bad thing. That is a good thing. Every time you invest in something, even if it’s the same thing you’ve already invested in, you have the opportunity to approach it as a different version of you in this current time with this current business that you have, and you have the opportunity to put money on the line to go out and commit and to get a return. If you have any questions that I did not cover on this, you can email my team, support@staceyboehman.com. There is also a fact page on the sales page at the very bottom.
